metadata.description: Temperature-dependent NRTL and UNIQUAC parameters for 1-butanol/water.

data_basis.description: 1-atm n-butanol/water LLE data from 302.95-397.75 K, plus the supplied 298.15 K tie-line point.

fit_diagnostics.overall: Both fits represent the measured binodal well over most of the temperature range, with the largest mismatch confined to the sharp near-critical closure. NRTL gives the slightly better overall LLE fit and critical composition; UNIQUAC gives the slightly closer UCST.
fit_diagnostics.caution: These are 1-atm fits only. The paper shows strong pressure-induced contraction of the miscibility gap, so the same fixed-gamma parameters should not be expected to reproduce the high-pressure data.
